note: The storage conformance cases of docs/storage-conformance.md: scenarios for the candle, journal and segment ports, each step with what a conforming store returns, and the dirty-window races each backend steps through. series_rule: candle i of a series, for i from 0 to count - 1 (only those in range [a, b) when a range is given, and none listed in skip): open_time_ms = from + i * spacing_ms (spacing_ms defaults to the market's interval step); close_time_ms = open_time_ms + step - 1; open, high, low and close are the close text when one is given, otherwise "{100 + i % 50}.{i % 100, two digits}"; volume is "0.50000000"; trades is open_time_ms modulo 97, never negative; candles are written in rising i

candles.doc: a market without candles reads nothing
an upsert counts the candles it was given, not the rows it added
a candle written again under its open time replaces every other column
a candle written again with any one column changed is stored with that change
of two candles with one open time in a batch, the later is kept
a load is ascending with both bounds included and keeps the oldest; recent keeps the newest, ascending
a range holding no candle, a zero limit and a reversed range read nothing
a bound on a candle's open time includes it, and one past it does not
the same open time on every product line, symbol and interval reads back only its own candle
every decimal column keeps the text it was written with, scale included

candles.doc: an unknown trade count stays unknown and is not zero
every trade count from 0 to the largest unsigned 64-bit one reads back unchanged
a batch holding a candle no segment window can hold is refused whole
a store opened again on the same database resumes from its newest candle
stored text a decimal cannot hold exactly is refused by every read that returns it, never rounded

segments.doc: a market without candles is all tip
a refresh packs every closed window and leaves the tip
candles written in any order pack to the same segments
a second refresh, and an identical resync, change nothing
a window changed and changed back keeps its segment
the window of the newest candle stays in the tip until a later window starts
a backfill reopens its window at once, the next refresh packs only that window, and the segment it replaced still loads
a corrected window is indexed under its new segment, and the segment it replaced stays stored and opens under its own name

jobs.doc: a bundle is stored once under its name, every byte kept, and loaded back; an unknown name loads nothing
a job is recorded queued with nothing else yet; a job ID twice and a bundle the store does not hold are refused
jobs are listed the last submitted first, at most as many as asked for
a claim takes the job submitted first of those queued and starts it; with none queued it takes nothing
a running job ends once, succeeded with its results or failed with why; a queued or ended job is left as it is
a queued or running job is cancelled, keeping when it started; an ended job stays as it is and an unknown one is not found
every running job, and nothing else, is failed with the reason given, as a server does as it starts

jobs.doc: a job's request, results and failure are kept as the text given, whatever it holds
a succeeded job's results are stored as it ends, every byte kept, and loaded back by name; an unknown name loads nothing, and a store opened again still holds them
an end that changes nothing stores nothing: not the results of a job cancelled as it ran, of one that had ended, of a queued one or of an unknown one; a failed job stores none
a result two jobs produce is stored once under its name: the second job ends with its results listed, and the bytes stored first stay
a job's log is stored once under the job, kept as the text given, and read back; a job with none reads nothing, a log stored again changes nothing, and a store opened again still holds it
